For every \(C,D\in\mathfrak S_p\), if \(\mathsf S(C)

body.justification: The pointwise router induces a finite universal test dictionary whose size is explicit before any data are observed.
body.gap: BoegeKubjasMisraSolus2026 decides equality using rational model constraints, whereas this result reduces inequality detection on the blocked class to finitely many binary stars.
